images.name: Neglected Flocks
images.scene: High on a ruined hillside sheepfold, two tiny back-facing hooded shepherds pull a single ragged fleece from a thin sheep while abandoned shearing frames and a broken stone aqueduct surround them. Autumn wheat grasses and muted olive cloth, a small pale fleece is the focal light. Viewed from above across a broad stone terrace; the visible quiet lower half is the terrace and sweeping worn steps, with low-contrast weeds, never a black void.

images.name: Salt Monopoly
images.scene: In the upper center of a broad neglected saltworks, a tiny hooded overseer in faded ochre receives a bowl of provisions beside a locked salt store while two back-facing laborers scrape one small salt pan. Long diagonals of broken shallow evaporation beds, weeds and cracked gates convey extortion and wasted capacity. The lower half shows coherent pale salt crust and subdued water reflections rather than a dark fade; small focal contrast on the miserly salt heap.

A daylight shaft catches their hands and the pale sheet. Large quiet worn flagstones and the rounded vat wall fill the lower half at restrained contrast, with fully visible material forms.

images.name: Falsified Ledgers
images.scene: Within the upper center of a vast crumbling counting hall, a tiny back-facing hooded clerk pockets a payment behind their back while placing one blank surviving ledger onto a high desk; swollen bundles of obsolete accounts slump under a leaking arch. Anonymous second hooded supplicant waits with empty hands. Viewed from a low side aisle with a decisive angled desk, small honey focal light on book and concealed payment. The lower half is a broad calm warm-stone aisle and a draped cloth, all visible and low contrast. No readable marks on the books.

images.name: Rusted Armoury

A bright small amber forge focal area, grey metal and muted olive patched aprons against warm stone; distant architecture dwarfs the figures. The lower half is a quiet but visible pale ash-covered floor and broad rounded forge base, never crushed blacks or artificial fade.

Hands, posture, distance and unequal piles tell the story of withheld rewards, no coins bearing symbols or readable faces. Strong triangular composition and a single small glint from the meagre open box; lower half is a coherent low-contrast expanse of warm stone stair and patched cloth.

images.name: Silted Channels
images.scene: In the upper central part of an immense broken aqueduct system, two small back-facing hooded laborers strain to lift one repaired sluice gate, releasing a thin bright trickle into a mostly dry silt-choked irrigation channel. Sweeping diagonal banks, cracked masonry and overgrown waterwheels dwarf them. Sunlit warm stone, muted olive vegetation, umber mud and small cool water accent. Lower half is a broad calm visible foreground of shallow cracked channel and restrained water ripples, not a black field.
